description: This file contains string processing utility functions used within the TestLink project, including functions for formatting, sanitizing, and converting strings for HTML display, email, URLs, and other contexts.

methods.name: string_preserve_spaces_at_bol
methods.description: Preserves leading spaces and tabs at the beginning of each line in a string, converting them into HTML non-breaking spaces.

methods.name: string_no_break
methods.description: Wraps a string in a span with nowrap class if it contains spaces, to prevent line breaks.

methods.name: string_nl2br
methods.description:
Converts newlines in a string to
tags, fixing multiple line breaks within 
 tags and optionally wrapping lines.

methods.name: string_display
methods.description: Prepares a multi-line string for HTML display, applying escaping, tag restoration, space preservation, and newline conversion.

methods.name: string_display_line
methods.description: Prepares a single-line string for HTML display, escaping and restoring valid HTML tags.

methods.name: string_display_links
methods.description: Displays a string with HTML escaping and inserts hyperlinks for URLs, emails, and bug/CVS references.

methods.name: string_display_line_links
methods.description: Displays a single line string with escaping and hyperlink insertion.

methods.name: string_rss_links
methods.description: Prepares string for RSS display by escaping, converting newlines, and inserting links for URLs, bugs, CVS, and email addresses.

methods.name: string_email
methods.description: Prepares a string for plain text email content, stripping out hrefs.

methods.name: string_email_links
methods.description: Prepares a string for email with links for bug and CVS references.

methods.name: string_textarea
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe display in a textarea HTML element.

methods.name: string_attribute
methods.description: Escapes a string for inclusion in HTML attributes.

methods.name: string_url
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in URL GET parameters.

methods.name: string_sanitize_url
methods.description: Sanitizes a URL by removing tags, validating protocol, and encoding parameters.

methods.name: string_insert_hrefs
methods.description: Converts URLs and email addresses in text into HTML anchor tags.

methods.name: string_strip_hrefs
methods.description: Removes href tags from a string, returning only the URL or email address.

methods.name: string_restore_valid_html_tags
methods.description: Restores safe HTML tags from encoded < and > entities based on configuration.

methods.name: string_repeat_char
methods.description: Repeats a character pattern multiple times to build a string.

methods.name: string_format_complete_date
methods.description: Formats a date string into a complete date format based on configuration.

methods.name: string_shorten
methods.description: Shortens a string to fit within a configured maximum length, preserving word boundaries.

methods.name: string_get_field_name
methods.description: Maps internal field names to display names, with optional localization.

methods.name: string_html_entities
methods.description: Converts special characters to HTML entities.

methods.name: string_html_specialchars
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe HTML display, considering current charset.

methods.name: string_prepare_header
methods.description: Prepares a string for safe use in email headers by truncating at newline characters.

methods.name: string_contains_scripting_chars
methods.description: Detects if a string contains potentially scripting characters like < or >.

methods.name: email_regex_simple
methods.description: Provides a simple regular expression for matching email addresses.
